text:
joel: Heads up 10% strict fncall canary in eu-west is producing rejects for the search_tool. Many logs show `result` present but `items` missing or null.
kiri: reject-rate ~2.6% in canary. sample shows older clients returning `result: null` when no results.
rana: did the schema change recently? we used to accept null for that field.
joel: yes, schema tightened to require `result.items: []` last week as part of typed-output push.
marta: that's going to break clients. we need a nonblocking fallback while we notify teams.
kiri: proposal: introduce a tool-level tolerant-mode that converts `result:null` -> `result.items:[]` and emit a telemetry tag `fncall.tolerant=true`.
rana: +1. Also add `validator_action` tag with values reject|tolerant_accept so queries can filter.
ops-bot: deploy: strict-fncall-validator canary=10% started at 2026-03-20T09:17:00Z
joel: operational tradeoffs: tolerant_accept will still bill tokens. If finance needs a separate meter we should tag route_id accordingly.
kiri: I'll wire a metric `fncall.rejects.missing_items` and enable sampling of 100 payloads to the sampling bucket.
marta: console UX: add a temporary toggle per-tool to enable tolerant-mode and surface sampled payload links. product owners can flip it.
rana: action items:
- rollback strictness for search_tool in eu-west canary -> joel
- enable tolerant_mode + sample 100 rejects -> kiri
- add validator_action tag and metric -> kiri
- console toggle for product owners -> marta
joel: will push rollback in next 10m and notify oncall.
marta: I'll add a small console note and a link to sampled payloads. also file a follow-up to coordinate breaking change with teams.
ops-bot: action logged: rollback requested (operator: joel)
rana: freezing further strict validator rollouts until we confirm clients are updated.
joel: thanks all. keep updates here and add the request_ids to the incident doc.
